svg.aria-label: Slicing rows with loc versus iloc on the same five-row DataFrame. df.loc[0:2] selects by label and includes the end label, so it returns rows 0, 1 and 2 (3 rows). df.iloc[0:2] selects by position and stops before position 2, so it returns rows 0 and 1 (2 rows).
svg.title: loc vs iloc
